title: State-Trait Anxiety Inventory, Form Y, Trait scale
description: 20 statements about how the respondent generally feels, each rated 1–4.

citation.text: Spielberger CD, Gorsuch RL, Lushene R, Vagg PR, Jacobs GA (1983). Manual for the State-Trait Anxiety Inventory. Palo Alto, CA: Consulting Psychologists Press.

scoring.text: Sum of the 20 items (20–80) after reversing the anxiety-absent items 1, 3, 6, 7, 10, 13, 14, 16 and 19. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
